items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: When I was doing the Joan Rivers Show, I was the musical arranger for the Joan Rivers late night show

ctx.x: I’ve had guys tell me that they had to be wary about going on the road, even if it was a good deal, because by the time they got back —

Out of sight, out of mind. So I would never tell people I was out for a week or a month or six months. When I was out of town for long periods of time, which I don’t do anymore, there were no cell phones. So now you don’t ever have to tell anybody you left town, you just get the call, and you could be in Ames, Iowa and say yeah, I’m around the corner, but I can’t meet you now because I have a — you know you fly home. When I was doing the Joan Rivers Show, I was the musical arranger for the Joan Rivers late night…
But I would make sure that neither would know I was out of town. So you’re doing a lot of juggling.
